iconicAnchor.label: Accumulated street-sticker surface
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The archive establishes sticker art as many small authored graphics accumulated on public surfaces, with overlap, tearing, fading, weathering, and repeated circulation shaping the final field.

sources.title: Sticker art collection finding aid
sources.publisher: Cornell University Library Rare and Manuscript Collections
supports: Sticker art operates through small-format graphics, anonymous and credited makers, street placement, repetition, layering, weathering, and collecting.

sources.title: Hatch Sticker Museum
supports: A dedicated sticker collection demonstrates the culture's diversity of voices, hand and print techniques, dense display, and relation to street art.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches collage, playful, vivid chroma, layered, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/sticker-bomb/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
